thread:
saira: Heads-up — planning a dedicated capacity cutover for gpu-pool-west-1 tomorrow 10:30 PDT. This will change the autoscale policy (target avg-latency -> 60ms) and reduce min-slices 6 -> 4. Who can own the deploy+rollback?
ryan: I can drive the deploy and take rollback responsibility. I'll be on stand-by 10:15-11:00. :thumbsup:
devon: I'll own smoke and metrics watch. Which dashboards + runbook should I follow?
saira: Runbook: https://go/repo/runbooks/gpu-cutover (same doc as previous cutovers) — follow sections 2/3 for staging smoke and canary. Dashboards: prod-gpu-west / autoscale-ops / kv-cache.
maria: @ryan PR #4523 contains the autoscaler change and the slice delta. Needs one more reviewer before we can merge. pinging @devon for a quick look.
devon: Looking now. Quick Q: the PR sets burstThreshold to 0.8 — did we decide to keep that or lower to 0.7 to avoid oscillation?
saira: Keep 0.8 for this cutover so we can measure behavior; we'll revert to 0.7 if we see oscillation next 24h. Note in runbook to capture metrics window.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: gpu-pool-west-1-autoscale-update by @ryan at 2439876543 (automated schedule entry)
ryan: Deploy plan (short): 1) apply config in staging, smoke there, 2) canary 20% traffic for 5m, 3) monitor p50/p95 and error rate, 4) cut to 100%. Rollback plan: revert autoscaler config + scale min-slices back to 6, then re-route traffic to previous pool. Abort criteria: p95 > 120ms or errors > 1% for 5m.
devon: Smoke checklist (I'll run and paste results):
```
- run loadgen: ./tools/loadgen --target prod-gpu-west --qps 50 --duration 3m
- check observability: p50/p95, errors, KV cache hit
- confirm autoscaler logs show scale decisions
- sanity-check embeddings correctness on sample prompts
```
I'll run the loadgen at 10:20 and post metrics.
maria: Can we get one more approval on the PR? @devon if you see anything in config comments please flag, otherwise I'll merge and tag @ryan.
dryan: (typo) sorry — meant @ryan :facepalm:
ryan: :raised_hands: merged PR #4523. Starting staging apply at 10:18. I'll mark 'started' here when I kick off the staging job.
saira: Thanks. Reminder: @ryan when you start the canary, set the canary window to 5m and annotate the runbook with the start/stop times. @devon paste smoke outputs as code blocks so we can easily copy graphs. If anything looks off, call the rollback and we'll execute within 10m.
devon: Copy that. I'll post the staging smoke results in this thread ~10:25.
ryan: Started staging apply at 10:18. Notifying when canary flips.
devon: Staging loadgen results:
```
- p50: 38ms
- p95: 74ms
- errors: 0.02%
- KV cache hit: 92%
```
Looks healthy for canary.
saira: Great. Proceed with 20% canary when ready.
ryan: Canary flip done at 10:34. Monitoring 5m.
maria: Alert configured: if errors > 1% or p95 > 120ms for 5m, playbook will notify oncall + pause traffic.
devon: Canary window ended; p95 peaked at 82ms, errors 0.05%, KV hit steady. No anomalies.
ryan: Rolling to 100% now. Will post final verification once done.
saira: If anyone sees regressions after full roll, call rollback. Otherwise I'll close this thread when all checks are green. Thanks team :)
